verdict.rationale: Inngest's own docs say functions can be written in TypeScript, Python, or Go with built-in steps, so the multi-language SDK core of the story is documented. Nothing in the pack shows feature parity across those SDKs, and some tooling cited (the v4 testing library, the ESLint plugin) is only shown for TypeScript. missing for 10: evidence of feature parity across the TypeScript, Python and Go SDKs, SDKs beyond those three, independent or hands-on corroboration of non-TypeScript SDKs.

support.subject: As a backend developer, I author workflows in the language my team already uses — TypeScript, Python, Go, or more — with real feature parity across SDKs

citations.quote: Write functions in TypeScript, Python or Go to power background and scheduled jobs, with steps built in.
you write standard TypeScript, Python, or Go functions using a simple SDK, and Inngest handles execution durability, state persistence, retries, and flow control for you
